app.name: DawaiCheck
app.shortDisclaimer: Packaging screening only - not proof that a medicine is genuine or safe.
app.disclaimer: This is a packaging screening aid, not a laboratory test. If in doubt, confirm with a licensed pharmacist or the Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP).
app.offline: You're offline. Saved results still open, but new scans need a connection.
app.localOnly: History stays in this browser and is never synced.

low.label: Low
low.quality_failed: The photos were too poor to screen reliably.
low.no_reference: No reference packaging matched, so visual checks were limited.
low.ocr_failed: Text could not be read reliably from these photos.

medium.label: Medium
medium.partial_evidence: Some checks were skipped or the photos had minor quality issues.
medium.some_uncertainty: The reference matched, but some evidence is less certain.

high.label: High
high.matched_reference: A reference matched by barcode and the photos were clear.

onboarding.privacyNote: Your photos are sent only to the screening service for analysis. Nothing is saved unless you choose to save it.
onboarding.slide1Title: Check the pack, not just the medicine.
onboarding.slide1Body: DawaiCheck compares packaging details and artwork with reference examples to show warning signs.
onboarding.slide1Note: It never proves a medicine is genuine or safe.
onboarding.slide2Body: Front, back and the batch/expiry panel. Good light and a steady hand make a real difference.
onboarding.slide3Body: Packaging checks cannot detect what is inside a pill. When in doubt, ask a licensed pharmacist or DRAP.

home.title: A second look before you take it.
home.subtitle: Photograph the front, back and batch panel. We check packaging warning signs - not what is inside the medicine.

recent.title: Recent results
recent.empty: Nothing saved yet. Your saved results will appear here.

how.title: What DawaiCheck looks at
how.subtitle: A quick packaging check with visible limits.
how.step1Body: Checks the GTIN, printed expiry, date order and batch format.
how.step2Body: Looks up a local demo registry and compares the printed name with a reference.
how.step3Body: Compares colour, layout and sharpness. It can flag differences, not prove tampering.

limits.title: Packaging can be checked. What's inside cannot.
limits.body: DawaiCheck cannot detect counterfeit ingredients or prove a medicine is safe. A consistent-looking box is not a guarantee.

demo.title: Built-in reference data is fictional
demo.body: The reference packs and registration records in this build are DEMO data. They are not real DRAP registrations.

home.footer: An independent packaging screening aid for Pakistan.

tips.title: Photo tips
tips.light: Use bright, even light and avoid glare.
tips.fill: Fill the frame and keep the text in focus.
tips.flat: Hold the box flat and steady.
tips.clean: Avoid fingers or shadows covering printed details.

analyzing.subtitle: This usually takes 10-20 seconds. Keep this screen open.
analyzing.warning: Photos are used only for this analysis and are not posted anywhere automatically.
analyzing.errorBody: The screening service could not complete this check. Try again.
analyzing.errorMissing: The photos are no longer available. Please retake them.
analyzing.networkBody: Check that the backend is running, then try again.

quality.title: Photo quality
quality.hint: Photo quality is checked before analysis. Poor photos lower confidence.

result.title: Screening result

consistent.title: Looks consistent
consistent.subtitle: The packaging matched the reference on the checks that could run.
consistent.note: This does not mean the medicine is genuine or safe.

suspicious.title: Suspicious packaging
suspicious.subtitle: One or more packaging checks raised a serious warning.
suspicious.note: Do not use the pack until a licensed pharmacist checks it.

risk.title: Packaging risk score
risk.hint: Not a probability. A higher score means more packaging warning signs.

comparison.noRegions: No significant difference areas were detected.

share.title: DawaiCheck result

pharmacist.title: Ask a licensed pharmacist
pharmacist.body: Show the pack and this result to a licensed pharmacist. They can inspect the packaging in person and advise you.
pharmacist.drap: If you suspect a counterfeit, contact the Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP). Keep the pack, photos and receipt.
pharmacist.urgent: If you have taken the medicine and feel unwell, seek medical care.

scoring.title: How the risk score works
scoring.body: Each check has a fixed weight. A failed check adds its full weight; a warning adds half. Photo quality is a gate, not a score. Unknown checks add no points but lower confidence.
scoring.threshold: A failed check or 15+ risk points makes the result suspicious. Without a reference, the result is undetermined.

saveDialog.title: Save this result on this device?
saveDialog.body: Saving stores this result and your photos in this browser only. Nothing is synced or uploaded to a history server. You can delete it at any time.
saveDialog.error: The result could not be saved. Browser storage may be full.

notFound.title: No result to show
notFound.body: Open a saved result or scan a pack to see a screening result here.

result.demoNotice: This result uses DEMO reference data.

photo_quality.title: Photo quality
photo_quality.why: Blur, darkness or glare can cause every other check to be less reliable.
photo_quality.failed: One or more photos are too poor to analyze. Retake them using the specific tips below.
photo_quality.warnings: Photos are usable, but quality warnings may reduce confidence.
photo_quality.passed: Photos are sharp enough and well lit for packaging screening.

expiry.title: Expiry date
expiry.why: An expired medicine should not be used, no matter how genuine the box appears.
expiry.missing: No expiry date was found. A carton without a readable expiry date should be verified.
expiry.unreadable: An expiry date was found but could not be read reliably.
expiry.expired: The printed expiry date ({{date}}) is in the past.
expiry.expiring_soon: The printed expiry date ({{date}}) is close. Confirm with a pharmacist.
expiry.valid: The printed expiry date ({{date}}) is in the future.

dates.title: Manufacturing and expiry dates
dates.why: The manufacturing and expiry dates should be in a believable order and shelf life.
dates.missing_mfg: No manufacturing date was found, so the shelf life could not be checked.
dates.unreadable_mfg: The manufacturing date could not be read reliably.
dates.missing_exp: The expiry date could not be read, so the date order was not checked.
dates.order: The manufacturing date is not before the expiry date.
dates.short_shelf_life: The printed shelf life is unusually short ({{months}} months).
dates.long_shelf_life: The printed shelf life is unusually long ({{months}} months).
dates.valid: The manufacturing and expiry dates are in a believable order ({{months}}-month shelf life).

batch_format.title: Batch number format
batch_format.why: A batch number that does not match the product's known format is a warning sign.
batch_format.missing: No batch number was found on the packaging.
batch_format.invalid_reference_rule: The reference batch format rule is invalid, so this check could not run.
batch_format.matches_ocr: The batch number matches the known format after common OCR character corrections.
batch_format.matches: The batch number matches the known format for this product.
batch_format.mismatch: The printed batch number does not match the known format for this product.
batch_format.plausible: A batch number is present and looks plausible. No format is known for this product.
batch_format.unusual: A batch number is present but its format looks unusual.

barcode.title: Barcode and GTIN
barcode.why: A valid GTIN check digit and the expected company prefix are useful packaging evidence.
barcode.missing: No barcode was detected in these photos.
barcode.invalid_checksum: The barcode number is not valid: its GTIN check digit does not match.
barcode.prefix_mismatch: The barcode does not match the company prefix for this product.
barcode.matches_reference: The barcode check digit is valid and its company prefix matches the reference.
barcode.valid_no_reference: The barcode check digit is valid. No reference prefix is available to compare.
barcode.non_gtin: A code was found, but it is not a GTIN/EAN number that can be validated.

registration.title: Registration number
registration.why: A registration number is only meaningful if it can be checked against a reliable registry.
registration.missing: No registration number was found on the packaging.
registration.registry_unavailable: The registration number is present, but no real registry is connected.
registration.not_found_demo: The registration number was not found in the local DEMO registry (which is not real DRAP data).
registration.not_found: The registration number was not found in the configured registry.
registration.found_but_unexpected: The registration number was found, but its format or registered product name does not fully match this pack.
registration.found_demo: The number appears in the local DEMO registry (not real DRAP data) as {{registry_name}}.
registration.found: The number was found in the configured registry as {{registry_name}}.

spelling.title: Product name and spelling
spelling.why: Small spelling changes are a common warning sign of counterfeit packaging.
spelling.no_reference: No reference name is available, so spelling could not be compared.
spelling.product_missing: The product name could not be read confidently, so spelling was not fully compared.
spelling.matches: The product name and manufacturer closely match the reference.
spelling.product_mismatch: The printed name "{{ocr_name}}" is substantially different from the reference "{{reference_name}}".
spelling.manufacturer_mismatch: The manufacturer name differs noticeably from the reference packaging.
spelling.close_but_differs: The printed name "{{ocr_name}}" is close to, but not an exact match for, the reference "{{reference_name}}".

visual.title: Packaging artwork
visual.why: Colour, layout and artwork differences can indicate a different or altered pack.
visual.no_reference: No reference packaging is available, so visual similarity could not be compared.
visual.comparison_unavailable: The visual comparison could not be completed for these photos.
visual.fail: The packaging artwork differs substantially from the reference image.
visual.warn: The packaging mostly resembles the reference, but some visual elements differ.
visual.pass: The packaging artwork closely resembles the reference image.

print_quality.title: Print quality
print_quality.why: Soft or uneven print can be a warning sign, although cameras and lighting can also affect it.
print_quality.no_reference: No reference packaging is available to compare print sharpness.
print_quality.unavailable: Print sharpness could not be compared with the reference.
print_quality.warn: Printed text looks less sharp than the reference. This is a warning only, not proof of tampering.
print_quality.pass: Print sharpness is broadly similar to the reference packaging.

common.quality_retake: Not evaluated because the photos did not pass the image quality gate.
common.ocr_failed: Not evaluated because printed text could not be read.

notices.demo_reference: Reference library: DEMO DATA - these are fictional packages, not real medicine registrations.
notices.demo_registry: Registration lookup uses a local DEMO CSV. It is not connected to DRAP and must not be treated as a real registration check.
notices.registry_unavailable: No real registry adapter is configured, so registration lookup is unavailable.
notices.registry_configured: Registration lookup uses the configured registry.
notices.no_reference: No reference packaging matched this product. Visual and spelling checks are limited, and confidence is lower.
notices.overrides_applied: Your corrected details were used for this re-check.
notices.vision_llm_used: Low-confidence OCR fields were supplemented by the optional vision model.
notices.vision_llm_failed: The optional vision model was unavailable; on-device OCR results were used.
notices.quality_failed: The photos were too poor to screen. Retake them using the tips on each capture step.
notices.quality_warnings: Some photos had quality warnings. Results are usable, but confidence may be lower.
notices.ocr_failed: Text could not be read from these photos. Retake them in good light and hold the camera steady.

limits.inside: It cannot detect what is inside the medicine.
limits.genuine: It cannot prove that a medicine is genuine.
limits.safe: A "consistent" result never means a medicine is safe.
limits.registry: The built-in registry is demo data, not a DRAP verification.
limits.visual: Artwork differences can have innocent causes, such as lighting or a packaging update.

verdicts.consistent: No failed check or major warning was found. The packaging still might not be genuine.
verdicts.suspicious: A failed check or enough warning points were found. Verify with a pharmacist.
verdicts.undetermined: The photos or reference were not good enough to decide. Retake photos or ask a pharmacist.

photos.light: Use bright, even light and avoid glare.
photos.fill: Fill the frame and keep printed text in focus.
photos.panel: Include the batch and expiry panel for every scan.

how.privacyBody: Photos are sent to the local backend for analysis. Saved results and photos stay in your browser and are removed when you delete them. Nothing is posted automatically.
how.drapBody: All products, manufacturers and registration numbers in the built-in reference library are fictional DEMO data. No live DRAP registry is connected. For a real verification, contact DRAP or a licensed pharmacist.
how.demoBody: They make it obvious that the app is a working prototype, not an official regulator service.
how.scoringBody: The risk score is the sum of weighted packaging checks. A failed check makes the result suspicious. Unknown checks add no points but reduce confidence. The score is not a probability.
